content_data.meeting_title: Strategic Roadmap for Renewable Energy Integration - Phase 2 Review
agenda_items: Resource allocation and budgeting for Phase 2 initiatives
Discussion on market trends impacting renewable energy adoption in North America
Risk assessment and mitigation strategies for regulatory changes
Review of Phase 1 implementation success metrics and challenges
Defining key performance indicators (KPIs) for Phase 2 success
key_decisions: Prioritize the development of a real-time energy management platform for Phase 2, focusing on smart grid integration.
Initiate stakeholder engagement with key regulatory bodies to align on policy frameworks for distributed energy resources.
Allocate an additional 15% of the budget to enhance cybersecurity measures for critical infrastructure components.
Form a cross-functional task force to evaluate emerging battery storage technologies within the next two weeks.
attendees: Mr. Jian Li, Head of Grid Modernization
Ms. Isabella Rossi, Director of Technology Innovation
Mr. David Chen, Principal Consultant (representing firm)
Dr. Anya Sharma, Lead Energy Strategist
